Get BNXT League Game

Source: R/sportpress.R
sportpress_game_find.Rd

One game: teams, scores, phase, venue and the neighbouring game ids.

Endpoint: GET https://bnxt.sportpress.info/api/v1/schedule/find/{game_id}

Usage

sportpress_game_find(game_id)

Arguments

game_id

(required) Game id (integer), unique across seasons; from sportpress_schedule() (game_id).

Value

A hoopR_data tibble: One game: teams, scores, phase, venue and the neighbouring game ids. An empty valid answer raises hoopR_no_data; the columns are always these, in this order (sdv-py sportpress_game_find):

col_nametypedescription
game_idintegerGame id (key space: sportpress games), unique across seasons: the key of every game route.
game_timePOSIXctTip-off as a naive datetime. The source carries no offset; the league's local time is assumed and unverified. POSIXct in Europe/Brussels (league local time).
statuscharacterGame status: finished, or ready for an upcoming game.
competition_idintegerCompetition id (key space: sportpress competitions): ONE season of the league (24 = 2025-26, 25 = 2026-27). Not the season number. The key of the standings, ranking, slider and box routes.
seasonintegerSeason END year (2026 = 2025-26), the sdv convention and the API's own season key.
phase_idintegerPhase id (key space: sportpress phases), a stage of one competition such as the regular season or the playoffs; new every season.
phase_namecharacterPhase name as entered in the CMS ('Regular season 2026-27').
round_namecharacterRound label as entered in the CMS; often empty.
round_priorityintegerSort order of the round within the phase (provider's priority); meaning of the values is unverified.
period_namecharacterName of the period the game is in or ended in; 'Extra2' means the second overtime.
arenacharacterName of the arena where the game is played.
home_competition_team_idintegerHome side. Competition-team id (key space: sportpress competition teams): a team in ONE competition, so the same club has a new id every season (Antwerp = 3 in 2021-22, 506 in 2025-26, 541 in 2026-27). Joins competitors, rosters, box scores, film and standings. The stable club key across seasons is uu_team_id.
home_teamcharacterHome side. Display name incl. the sponsor. Teams of the playoff phases carry a ' playoff' suffix (2025-26), and standings names vary with X-Localization ('Partena Professional Okapi Aalst Playoff' (en) vs 'Okapi Aalst Playoff' (nl, fr)): never join on it.
home_team_short_namecharacterHome side. Three-letter club code (CHA, OOS, ANT, MON, LIM, ...), stable across seasons in the samples.
home_scoreintegerHome side. Final points of the side, including overtime.
away_competition_team_idintegerAway side. Competition-team id (key space: sportpress competition teams): a team in ONE competition, so the same club has a new id every season (Antwerp = 3 in 2021-22, 506 in 2025-26, 541 in 2026-27). Joins competitors, rosters, box scores, film and standings. The stable club key across seasons is uu_team_id.
away_teamcharacterAway side. Display name incl. the sponsor. Teams of the playoff phases carry a ' playoff' suffix (2025-26), and standings names vary with X-Localization ('Partena Professional Okapi Aalst Playoff' (en) vs 'Okapi Aalst Playoff' (nl, fr)): never join on it.
away_team_short_namecharacterAway side. Three-letter club code (CHA, OOS, ANT, MON, LIM, ...), stable across seasons in the samples.
away_scoreintegerAway side. Final points of the side, including overtime.
last_game_idintegerLatest finished meeting of the same two teams in the competition, which can be LATER than this game; null when none.
next_game_idintegerNext meeting of the same two teams; null in every sample.

Details

  • Unofficial and unsupported: the Sportpress API is the JSON backend of bnxtleague.com, not a documented public API. Every route needs a header key; it is public (hard-coded in the site bundle), bnxt_runtime reads it from the bundle at run time, falls back to a documented value when the bundle cannot be read, and never prints or logs it. A 401 raises AssetFetchError (key rotated?). robots.txt allows everything; requests are spaced at least 1 s apart. Payloads are not redistributed as release assets.

  • Season key: the END year (season=2026 is 2025-26), the API's own key on the season routes. Every other route is keyed by the competition id (one per season: 1 = 2021-22, 2 = 2020-21, 3 = 2022-23, 12 = 2023-24, 22 = 2024-25, 24 = 2025-26, 25 = 2026-27), the competition-team id (new every season; uu_team_id is the stable club), the roster id (player x team x season) or the game id (unique across seasons). sportpress_phases(season) maps a season to its competition id.

  • Coverage: schedule and rosters from 2021-22 (2020-21 is empty); box scores for 2021-22, 2024-25, 2025-26 and 2026-27 (2022-23 and 2023-24 answer empty); standings and averages for 2021-22 and 2024-25 on; play-by-play ('film', with court x/y) for 2021-22 and 2026-27 only: for 2022-23 to 2025-26 use Genius play-by-play through genius_id (sportpress_game_slider(), organisation BNXT). The game routes (box score, film, overview) refuse a game that is not finished (AssetFetchError).

  • Data notes: a team's box total can differ from the schedule final score on about 18 of 1,246 sampled team boxes (mostly 2024-25, by 2-21 points); the frames report what the API serves. nationality_code is dirty (lower case, USA/BEL pairs, empty, HOL). Names differ by language and sponsor: join on ids. Contact and social fields are dropped; only a player's public birth date is kept. The sibling tenants sopron.sportpress.info and beac.sportpress.info are not wrapped.

  • Errors are classed conditions: hoopR_no_data (HTTP 404, an empty data list: an unknown id or a season without data, an empty ranking), hoopR_bad_request (an id or season that is not an integer, HTTP 400 / 422) and hoopR_asset_fetch (a rejected key after one renewal, any other non-200, a non-JSON or empty body, an error or changed envelope, a game that is not finished, a body for another season, competition, team or game), all inheriting hoopR_error. Wrappers raise; they never return an empty frame for a failed request. Whole doubles (24) are accepted for integer arguments.
